stage_definitions.assigned: Owner and writable paths explicitly assigned; no implementation claim.
stage_definitions.source_implemented: Source/data interfaces reviewed and original versus development policy distinguished.
stage_definitions.component_tested: Focused executed tests with recorded compiler, source revision and actual-data or fixture scope.
stage_definitions.runtime_integrated: Connected executable behavior exercised with logs/captures and matching source/EXE hashes.
stage_definitions.reference_compared: Actual original/video frames and matched runtime states inspected with version/viewport/equipment/timing qualifications.
stage_definitions.release_accepted: All applicable gates satisfied; full gameplay and visual contract remains required.

release_gates.required: Feature has one source owner and public interface; root owns main/CMake integration, HUD alignment owner controls HUD geometry. Changes outside ownership need explicit coordination.
Identify original resource IDs, serialized units, selection rules and unsupported branches. Fixture constants, forced conditions and diagnostic placements remain explicit.

Use same ActorState/World/property authority and retained clock. Borrow each actual original RNG owner/stream (AnimationRandom, application channels, combat source as proved); never collapse distinct streams or create new seeded substitutes.
Borrowed actors/visuals/native bodies/providers survive callbacks. Detach before roster replacement; rebind or fail before use. Generation guards reject obsolete completion/event/motion delivery.
Preserve synchronous source event order, failures, state forwarding, actor reactions and root-motion chronology. Do not replace exact callbacks with timers or duplicate queued hits.

Persist new authoritative state with explicit schema/content compatibility and reset policy, or reject saves/restores before mutation while providers are unpersisted. Test existing-file preservation and reload/restart.
Executed checks cover actual original data where available and relevant edge/failure cases. Fixture tests prove mechanisms only.
Root-integrated build executes feature alongside existing movement/combat/HUD/source clocks. Record baseline regressions, live values, source/EXE identity, clean shutdown and negative cases.
Inspect matched original/reference state for appearance, equipment, pose/timing, camera, lighting/material/FX, HUD and observable gameplay. Original asset loading alone is not parity.
Package final EXE/assets with manifest hashes and verify actual runtime receipts against that exact package; preserve prior accepted checkpoint.

cross_feature_risks.risk: Combo, skills, reactions, AI, cinematics and companions may compete with retained player/NPC clocks.
cross_feature_risks.integration_rule: One sampling owner per actor/action; transitions and outgoing events preserve source generations.

cross_feature_risks.risk: Skills/status/DOT/leech/loot/XP may mutate victim or attacker during synchronous source hit/state-forward callback.
cross_feature_risks.integration_rule: Consume full source result through one shared authority; guard reentry and callback lifetime; no duplicate direct health application.

cross_feature_risks.risk: Menus, starting loot, equipment visuals/combat facts and save compatibility may diverge.
cross_feature_risks.integration_rule: One item-instance inventory and source loadout binding; update visual/body/stat consumers together or transactionally reject incompatible restore.

cross_feature_risks.risk: Quests, spawning, doors, dialogue, triggers and cinematics may each own unrelated condition facts.
cross_feature_risks.integration_rule: Use source scheduler/condition/module identity and explicit providers; do not infer active state from map names or actor visibility.

cross_feature_risks.risk: PF user/body/filter/contact and source module room IDs may be substituted by rendering geometry/ordinal guesses.
cross_feature_risks.integration_rule: Preserve distinct source receiver identities; actual Step/AIS services remain required for collision acceptance.

cross_feature_risks.risk: Concurrent UI changes may overwrite HUD geometry or display stale derived actor values.
cross_feature_risks.integration_rule: HUD geometry changes belong to assigned owner; read live canonical vitals/target/inventory and source art/layout.

cross_feature_risks.risk: Attack/death/cinematic events may spawn effects or audio twice or leave stale handles after restore.
cross_feature_risks.integration_rule: Key delivery by source event/generation, own handles explicitly and define restore/reload cleanup.
